guaranteeScope: Package compatibility guarantees archive layout, manifest placement, and byte integrity. Runtime compatibility remains conditional on each skill's declared tools, authentication, network, and data requirements.

standaloneZip.layout: One top-level {name}/ directory containing SKILL.md and the complete canonical skill.

standaloneSkill.layout: Byte-identical ZIP payload to standaloneZip with the .skill extension.

skills.name: advisor-review
skills.notes: The package can be uploaded anywhere that accepts the archive layout, but the nested local Codex CLI process cannot run in a web-only skill sandbox.

skills.name: agent-finish-line
requirements: tools needed to complete the user's target action
skills.notes: Web runtimes must expose a writable workspace and the action tools required by the finish contract.

skills.name: katok-reply-reuse
requirements: macOS KakaoTalk archive authorized by the user
skills.notes: A web-only runtime cannot access the user's local authorized KakaoTalk archive.

skills.name: learnus-course-copilot
skills.notes: The skill deliberately depends on an existing local browser login and does not accept copied credentials or cookies.

skills.name: quant-stock-technical
requirements: user-provided finalized OHLCV and benchmark files
skills.notes: Web runtimes must support bundled Python scripts and uploaded input files.

skills.name: stock-scenario-story
skills.notes: The skill is never standalone at runtime even though its upload archive is standalone.

skills.name: yonsei-central-student-governance-counsel
requirements: outbound access to official publication paths
web or browser fallback for changed or blocked sources
skills.notes: The packaged corpus is self-contained, but current-rule advice requires live source-lineage checks.

excludedSkills.name: quant-stock-polling-trader
